rules.why: front knee bent, shin angled forward
back knee bent about 90 deg on the kick plate
hips high, head below the hips looking down

text.action: a swimmer set on the starting block in the take-your-marks position
text.core: Crouched on the starting block: left foot at the front edge with the toes curled over it, right foot back on the raised kick plate with the heel up; both hands gripping the front edge of the block; hips high above the head, back rounded forward; head down, eyes on the water just in front of the block.
text.gaze: Eyes down at the water in front of the block.
cues: weight slightly back, ready to pull and push
one foot at the front edge (the rule)
absolutely still until the start signal
kinetic: perfectly still, tension in the hamstrings
avoid: swimmer standing on the pool floor
body floating high out of the water
hair floating without a swim cap
both feet side by side at the back of the block

sources.cite: World Aquatics Swimming Rules SW 4 (start), SW 5 (freestyle), SW 7 (breaststroke), SW 8 (butterfly) and Facilities Rules FR 2 - general knowledge, not re-checked this session
